thread:
Maya: Quick preflight — finalizing the launch newsletter for the Benchmark webinar. Need segment defs, holdback %, and send windows. Goal: maximize opens for APAC morning and NA afternoon. Draft send times: Tue 10am PT / Wed 9am GMT for APAC. cc @Jordan for deliverability. Draft here: https://redwood.company/marketing/newsletter/benchmark-launch-draft

Jordan: +1 on timing. Suggest 10% holdback control and a 5% resend pool for non-openers. Suppression: churn + bounces in last 30d. I'll run deliverability checks tomorrow. :white_check_mark:

Priya: Subject lines ready. A/B test two variants — creative wants clear differentiator. Code:
```
A: Benchmark webinar — Cut inference costs by 3x
B: How we ran a 3x cheaper LLM inference
```
Also add personalization token for {{company_name}} and locale fallback for APAC.

Leo: Segment asks — can we split by ARR tier + product usage? Proposal: Enterprise (>$100k ARR), Mid-market (10-100k), Seed (<10k). Different CTAs per tier: schedule demo vs watch recording vs join community. Also create 'never engaged' micro-seg for reactivation.

Andres: Creative update — hero + CTA variants done, uploading to Figma by EOD. For tracking, use UTMs: utm_campaign=benchmark_launch&utm_source=newsletter&utm_medium=email&utm_content={variant} — will add to all links.

Maya: Notes: keep subject variant B for enterprise (case-study tone). @Jordan can you confirm DKIM/SPF/DMARC for sending domain? @Priya prefer send cadence: main send + resend at +48h to non-openers with subject 'Reminder: Benchmark webinar recording'.

Jordan: DKIM/SPF ok, DMARC enforcement passes for sending domain. I'll run a seed deliverability test (1k addresses) and warm-up if we see any issues. Also recommend throttling APAC sends in 30m batches to avoid spikes.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: scheduled send preview created — 2026-04-11T17:00:00Z for segment 'All -> segmented (holdback applied)'. Preview: https://app.sendplatform/preview/1794556677

Maya: Locking plan: 10% control holdback, 5% resend pool, resend +48h, subject mappings as above, UTMs in place. @Leo please confirm CTAs in Figma. I'll do final sign-off tomorrow 9am PT. :rocket:

Priya: I'll set up the Mailer experiments and seed test tonight (1000 addresses). Will upload variant mappings in the campaign doc.

Jordan: I'll run warmup and deliverability run at 8am PT tomorrow and share results in this thread.

Andres: Uploaded creatives and Figma links — leaving notes on CTA copy.

Maya: Thanks team — putting this on my calendar to approve at 9am PT. If anyone sees a blocker before then ping me directly.
